subject: Pilot acceptance: success metrics & acceptance probes

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>

Subject: Pilot acceptance: success metrics & acceptance probes

Thanks again for the time today, Samantha — really appreciated the product tour and the clarity on your pilot objective (reduce triage time for care coordinators). As promised, attached is a concise mutual action plan (MAP) draft that focuses only on the evaluation success criteria, exit gates, and the acceptance tests we will run during the 4-week pilot.

Highlights from the MAP (top-level):
- Primary success metric: end-to-end triage suggestion precision >= 88% on your labeled holdout at day 21.
- Performance SLOs: p95 latency for the 2k token generation path <= 300ms (region us-west), sustained throughput >= 80 requests/minute for typical burst windows.
- Safety/guardrails: query redaction applied, webhook audit logs enabled; no P0 security incidents during pilot.
- Cost target: average inference cost <= $0.85 per 1k tokens (pilot-weighted average).
- Acceptance probes (what we will run): smoke test suite (connectivity + auth + basic generation), labeled concordance suite (10k labeled samples subset), latency load test (10-minute ramp), and regression prompt set (customer-provided).

Exit gates (what must be true to move to a staged rollout):
1) Smoke pass (all critical checks) + infra stability for 48h.
2) Concordance >= 88% on holdout OR documented acceptance from your PM if there's a known label mismatch.
3) No blocking security items (IT sign-off on SOC2 evidence or equivalent).
4) Mutually agreed rollback plan and cost forecast signed off.

I've attached: Healthly_MAP_v0.3.xlsx (MAP with owners/timeline), acceptance-test-cases.jsonl (sample test vectors), and a smoke-test-results-template.docx.

Proposed timeline: kick off week of Jun 7 (integration + 3 days), week of Jun 14 run full labeled concordance + load tests, decision checkpoint Jun 28. If that works I'll send a formal calendar invite with owners.

One ask from your side: can you share the 10k labeled holdout (or a secure link) by EOD Jun 8 so we can seed the concordance runs? If legal/IT need to join the initial tech call, happy to include them.

Thanks — M

Adding internal alignment notes and owners so we have a clean handoff for the kickoff: 
- Integration & infra (owner: Dylan Brooks): VPC peering checklist, KMS access, and streaming endpoint readiness. See attached smoke-test-results-template.docx as the runbook default.
- Evaluation engineering (owner: Ben Carter): ingest holdout, run concordance and regression prompt sets, and produce the labeled-concordance report. acceptance-test-cases.jsonl will be our canonical test vector file.
- Customer success (owner: Marissa Cole): coordinate clinical sign-off, cadence with Healthly, and follow up on procurement path if they want Dedicated.

Draft internal acceptance rubric (for reference during tests):
- Critical (blocker): API auth fails, model returns hallucinated PHI, or any security evidence gap.
- Major (requires fix): concordance < 80% OR p95 latency > 700ms for 2k tokens.
- Minor (workaround acceptable): tokens cost variance +/- 20% from forecast OR concordance 80-88% with clearly documented failure modes.

I uploaded the three artifacts to the Healthly pilot folder on our Drive and updated the MAP with owners in column D.

Ben
